ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (outer lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (central peduncle and medial regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region forming a central Y-shape from the base to the notch; high-intensity white regions localized on the lateral lobes. Distinct circular low-intensity blobs (mottling) are concentrated on the right lateral lobe (x=70-90% range).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with high-frequency variations; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 2 to 15 pixels, with the highest degree of jaggedness on the distal-lateral boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric upward convex curve originating from the median notch vertex and terminating at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of ~25 circular high-contrast pixel rings (dark on white) primarily clustered on the right lateral lobe and ~8 on the left lateral lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct horizontal high-intensity linear streaks (scratches) detected within the central low-intensity black region; one diagonal linear disruption in the lower-left white quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly textured, raised clusters of high-intensity pixels (calcified organisms) localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes.
